blocks.text: What to Know About Pre and Post-Care with a HydraFacial Treatment

blocks.html: There are certain products you will want to discontinue using (such as Accutane) for one week before treatment. You will also want to discontinue the use of topical Retin-A or generic tretinoin for at least 48 hours before and after treatment.

Do not use any type of exfoliating treatments, such as glycolic acid or enzymes for 24 hours before treatment. Do not use any chemical peels or laser treatments for one week before your HydraFacial treatment. Do not use any depilatories and refrain from waxing for 48 hours before treatment.

Avoid excessive sun exposure and artificial tanning beds in the few days before a treatment is scheduled. If you receive Botox or other fillers, wait one week to undergo those treatments. For men, shaving is not recommended on the day of treatment. Try to refrain from applying makeup on the day of your HydraFacial treatment near Cedar Park.
